description_en: Imports directional cards into a directional group
description_zh: 给定向分组中导入定向卡
kebab_example: aliyun linkcard add-directional-card --group-id 5 --upload-type ALL --upload-method TAG --tag-list 5 --order-list 217200080589 --file-uri https://linkcard-user-online.oss-cn-zhangjiakou.aliyuncs.com/DIRECTIONAL_GROUP/20220811/xxxx.csv --group-name '测试分组' --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddDirectionalCard

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the directional group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/374328.html operation and view the directional group ID (DirectionalGroupId) in the response parameters
parameters.help_zh:
定向分组ID。

您可调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/374328.html在返回参数中查看定向分组ID（DirectionalGroupId）
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The import type. Valid values:

NO_GROUP: imports only directional cards that have not been assigned to a group.

ALL: imports all directional cards
parameters.help_zh:
导入类型。

NO_GROUP：仅导入还未分组的定向卡。

ALL：全量导入
parameters.name: upload_type

parameters.help_en:
The import method. Valid values:

TAG: imports directional cards with the specified tags.

ORDER: imports directional cards from the specified orders.

FILE: imports directional cards from a batch file
parameters.help_zh:
导入方式。

TAG：标签，导入指定标签的定向卡。

ORDER：订单，导入指定订单的定向卡。

FILE：批量文件，导入批量文件中的定向卡
parameters.name: upload_method

parameters.help_en: The list of tag IDs. This parameter is required when the import method is set to TAG
parameters.help_zh: 标签ID列表。导入方式选择为标签时，需填入该参数
parameters.name: tag_list

parameters.help_en: The list of order IDs. This parameter is required when the import method is set to ORDER
parameters.help_zh: 订单编号列表。导入方式选择为订单时，需填入该参数
parameters.name: order_list

parameters.help_en: The OSS path of the batch file. This parameter is required when the import method is set to FILE
parameters.help_zh: 批量文件的OSS路径。导入方式选择为批量文件时，需填入该参数
parameters.name: file_uri

parameters.help_en: The name of the directional group
parameters.name: group_name
